parent_objective: refresh full L0/L1/L2/L3 go/no-go profile configs without training
blocked_by: current corrected config set lacks L2_window_50_current_tiled and L2_window_100_current_tiled controls required by the full matrix
supersedes: using M1207 configs unchanged as the final paper-grade go/no-go matrix

public_gates: M1493 must generate or refresh full go/no-go profile configs without training
M1493 must include current-tiled controls for every finite-window L2 profile
M1493 must preserve P0 human-view/no-wheel/no-oracle input flags
M1493 must include focused tests for current-tiled dimensions and corrected reset policy
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim architecture ranking or recurrent self-identification

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: adds full matrix config coverage, especially L2 50/100 current-tiled controls, before any fixed-budget run
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure only; no replay run, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if generated configs add hidden or oracle actor inputs
stop if current-tiled controls do not preserve matched L2 observation dimensions
stop if L3 reset-control runtime semantics are not enforceable
stop if implementation starts training or evaluation
fallback_plan: route to profile-control repair if current-tiled or reset-control semantics fail
route to runtime smoke only if all configs and tests pass

admission_evidence: M1492 requires full L2 finite-window and current-tiled controls before fair matrix training
existing corrected configs include current-tiled controls only for window 13 and 25
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: current-tiled controls exist for every finite-window L2 profile

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1493 creates current-tiled controls explicitly to measure current-frame substitution rather than assume history use.
history_necessity_tests: config-level support for L2 normal versus L2 current-tiled controls
config-level support for L3 online versus corrected reset-control
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: infrastructure only; no new temporal evidence generated.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If config/runtime controls cannot be made clean, do not run the matrix; repair infrastructure first.
allowed_claims: M1493 refreshes full go/no-go profile configs
no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The existing profile infrastructure can be refreshed into a full, contract-clean go/no-go matrix config set before any new training.
success_criteria: full matrix configs are generated or refreshed
L2_window_13/25/50/100 current-tiled controls exist and preserve observation dimensions
no training PPO replay promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: current-tiled controls are missing for any selected finite-window L2 profile
forbidden actor input flags are true
L3 reset-control semantics cannot be enforced
training replay PPO promotion corpus export or actor-input change occurs

commands.name: implementation
commands.command: refresh full go/no-go profile configs and focused tests

decision_rule: M1493 passes if full contract-clean go/no-go profile configs and focused tests are ready before any training or runtime smoke.
